text: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16): (B) guidance: CO/enterprise Space owners SHOULD be organization service DIDs, not personal DIDs; plus (A) optional but RECOMMENDED (SHOULD): a Space guardian (backup DID or k-of-n quorum) fixed at genesis that can sign an ownership transfer after a waiting period (e.g. 72 h) during which the current owner may object; fallback (C) re-found the Space. Also write the non-decision incident procedures: logger/recorder key rotation and re-encryption, manifest status revoked, provisioning-key compromise bulk response.
